title: Right torsors under arbitrary pro-etale group sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with the small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], in compatible universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $H$ be a sheaf of possibly noncommutative groups on that site. A right $H$-torsor is a sheaf of sets $P$ and restriction-compatible maps $P(U)\times H(U)\to P(U)$, written $(s,g)\mapsto sg$, satisfying $s1=s$ and $(sg)h=s(gh)$, such that for every $U$ and $s\in P(U)$ the function $g\mapsto sg$ is bijective, and the sieve of $V\to U$ with $P(V)$ nonempty is covering for every $U$. For $s,t\in P(U)$ define the transition coefficient $\delta(s,t)\in H(U)$ by applying the inverse of the bijection $g\mapsto sg$ to $t$. Thus it is the unique coefficient with $t=s\delta(s,t)$.
